name: 50049 · Chariton, IA
findings: ZIP 50049 (Chariton) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (14%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50049 (Chariton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 50049 (Chariton) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
